ship.releaseNotes: Published via rolling release channels (`full`, `app`, `engines`, `toolchain`). See `docs/RELEASE-CHANNELS.md`.
ship.appOnlyReleaseNotes: Lean portable update (~7 MB): app executable, factory templates, plugin catalog, Foundry vendor patches, bundled 7z, and pi-subagents extension. Keeps installed engines and toolchains untouched.
ship.fullBundleReleaseNotes: Includes Blackwell Ops plus the EDGE engine seed. First run pulls the matching CUDA runtime automatically; STABLE and Foundry build tools are optional 1-click downloads in CONFIG -> UPDATES.
